draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.99, the 134th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 8th of 21 at S. He lasted until pick 180, well after his grade rank (134th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (5th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (7th percentile). College production: 62 tackles in 2020, 6th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Denver Broncos. 66 career games and 54 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 10 AV in 2025 against a career-best 13 in 2022. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 10 (96th percentile), passes defended 11 (95th percentile), combined tackles 106 (90th percentile). Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 safety who played: 96.4% season snap share against a median of 59.9%, above the norm.
